name: @equaltoai/contentus
description: Contentus — the FaceTheory + greater-components CMS client installed into lesser instances.

scripts.build:assets: node scripts/copy-facetheory-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-stylesheet.mjs && node scripts/copy-brand-assets.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run svelte-check && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:assets && pnpm run validate
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:renderer-authority && pnpm run validate:csp

comments.renderer_authority: Contentus ships NO Markdown rendering pipeline. lesser's server-side renderer/sanitizer (pkg/cmsrender) is the single authority for article HTML. The `unified`/`rehype-*`/`hast-util-sanitize` deps are present for exactly one reason: the vendored greater blog face's Article.Content imports `sanitizeHtml` from src/lib/greater/utils, which is greater's HTML SANITIZER (defence-in-depth over lesser's authority) — not a renderer. The Markdown RENDERING chain (remark-parse, remark-gfm, remark-rehype, mdast-*, shiki) is deliberately absent: the only vendored files that need it are MarkdownRenderer.svelte, html-to-markdown.ts, and CodeBlock.svelte, none of which contentus imports. `scripts/audit-renderer-authority.mjs` enforces both halves of this line on every build. See docs/consumption/renderer-authority.md.
comments.greater_cli_findings: Two `greater` CLI defects hit during the M1 vendoring at greater-v0.11.9, both routed upstream rather than worked around: (1) `greater add` rewrote contentus-owned package.json devDependencies to nonexistent versions (vite ^10.0.1, @types/node ^3.1.0, @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte ^10.1.2, typescript ^6.0.0, svelte-check ^9.0.1, prettier ^2.1.2) and replaced the pinned greater-components-adapters tarball with the nonexistent range ^11.0.5 — package.json is contentus-owned, so it was restored, not patched around; (2) vendored source is emitted with bare, unresolvable specifiers (`from 'src/lib/greater/utils'`) in 65 files — the CLI substitutes the components.json alias TARGET instead of an alias-prefixed path. Fixed host-side with a resolve alias in vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json paths; no vendored file was hand-edited. BOTH REPRODUCE AT greater-v0.12.0 (M2d pin bump), which is what makes them standing defects rather than one bad build: #918 emitted a fresh set of nonexistent ranges (prettier ^10.1.2, typescript ^3.1.0, vite ^2.1.2, @types/node ^0.14.0, @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte ^3.2.0, svelte-check ^4.0.9) and again replaced every greater tarball pin with an invented semver range (adapters ^16.12.0, headless ^2.47.14, icons ^3.19.0, primitives ^6.0.6, tokens ^11.0.0, utils ^4.0.1) — a manifest no `--frozen-lockfile` install can resolve. It also ADDED the Markdown rendering chain contentus refuses (remark-parse, remark-gfm, remark-rehype, mdast-util-*, hast-util-to-mdast, shiki) plus Apollo, graphql, and viem as direct dependencies. The manifest was restored from the pre-run copy and only the greater tarball URLs were moved to 0.12.0 by hand; `pnpm install` then pruned the additions, and the renderer-authority audit is what proves the Markdown chain did not survive.
comments.greater_channels: Two upstream-sanctioned channels, both `greater` CLI managed, pinned in lockstep to greater-v0.12.0: (1) TARBALL-PIN for compiled sub-packages imported as npm modules; (2) CLI-COPY (`installMode: vendored`) for faces and shared modules, recorded in components.json. Vendored source is never hand-edited — updates flow through the CLI. The M2d bump from 0.11.9 moved both channels in one commit because CON-4 requires it: every components.json `installed[]` entry must carry the pinned `vendored_ref`, so the whole vendored tree is re-emitted by the CLI rather than one module being added at a newer ref. Face 2's review chrome (the `review` registry entry) exists only from greater-v0.12.0, which is what forced the bump.
comments.facetheory_pin: FaceTheory v4.0.1 release tarball, matching the proven simulacrum consumption pattern. lesser's CLIENT_APP_GUIDE.md still documents 3.2.2 as the recommended pin; `lesser client install` validates only that @theory-cloud/facetheory is present, so 4.0.1 satisfies the contract. Reported to Factory as a stale-doc follow-up.
